passive.name: Cursed Touch
passive.description: Amumu's basic attacks Curse his enemies, causing them to take bonus true damage from incoming magic damage.

primaryAbilities.name: Bandage Toss
primaryAbilities.description: Amumu tosses a sticky bandage at a target, stunning and damaging the target while he pulls himself to them.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Amumu launches a bandage, pulling himself to the first enemy hit, Stunning them for {{ stunduration }} second, and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage.

This Ability has 2 charges.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Despair
primaryAbilities.description: Overcome by anguish, nearby enemies lose a percentage of their maximum Health each second and have their Curses refreshed.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: <toggle>Toggle:</toggle> Amumu begins crying, dealing <magicDamage>{{ basedamage }} plus {{ totalhealthdamage }}% max Health magic damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies every second and refreshing <keywordMajor>Curse</keywordMajor>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Tantrum
primaryAbilities.description: Permanently reduces the physical damage Amumu would take. Amumu can unleash his rage, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Each time Amumu is hit, the cooldown on Tantrum is reduced.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Passive: Amumu takes {{ damagereduction }} reduced physical damage. Additionally, when Amumu is hit by an Attack, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced by {{ cdronhit }} seconds.

Active: Amumu throws a tantrum, dealing {{ tantrumdamage }} magic damage to nearby enemies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Curse of the Sad Mummy
primaryAbilities.description: Amumu entangles surrounding enemy units in bandages, applying his Curse, damaging and stunning them.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Amumu flares out his bandages, <status>Stunning</status> for {{ rduration }} seconds, dealing <magicDamage>{{ rcalculateddamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and applying <keywordMajor>Curse</keywordMajor>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
